title: A single affine tensor section detects generation of a line stalk
statement: Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], M a quasi-coherent O_Y-module [pqf-def-coherent], N an O_X-module, and φ:f* M→N [def-pc-module-pullback]. Fix affine opens V⊆Y and B⊆X with B⊆f⁻¹V and a free generator e of N on B [def-sc-local-free-generator]. For x∈B the stalk map φ_x is surjective if and only if there are a∈Γ(V,M) and α∈Γ(B,O_X) with φ(1⊗a)|B=αe and x∈D(α). No finite generation assumption on M is required.

source.place: Tags 01NK and 01O9, generator-open characterization; expanded affine tensor-section/local-maximal-ideal argument in step 1 of lem-trf-line-proj-chart-pullback.

proof.text: Represent a preimage of the frame germ on a neighborhood and shrink it inside B to an affine neighborhood C. The affine tensor-pullback section isomorphism writes the representative as a finite sum of coefficients times pulled-back sections a from V.

Reuse the existing private stalk_generator_bijective theorem from WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.NonvanishingSectionTrivializes by a proof-only import all; it says that the germ of the given free generator identifies the target stalk with the local ring. If every image coefficient were a nonunit, all their germs and every finite linear combination would lie in the maximal ideal, contradicting that the selected image is the frame germ. Thus one coefficient is a unit. Conversely a unit coefficient yields a basis in the image, hence surjectivity. The basic-open membership criterion says precisely that this germ is a unit.

proof_origin.place: Expansion of the generator-open argument at Tags 01NK and 01O9 using affine tensor pullback.

theorem affine_tensor_generator_locus {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (N : X.Modules)
    (φ : (tensorPullback f).obj M ⟶ N)
    (V : Y.affineOpens) (B : X.affineOpens) (hB : B.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    (e : Γ(N, B.1)) (he : IsFreeGenerator e) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ B.1) :
    Function.Surjective
        ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map φ.mapPresheaf) ↔
      ∃ (a : Γ(M, V.1)) (α : Γ(X, B.1)),
        φ.app B.1 (((tensorPullback f).obj M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hB).op
          (tensorPullbackSection f M V.1 a)) = α • e ∧ x ∈ X.basicOpen α
